title: Nice Oven Kenyan Lamb Bake
description: A flavorful and hearty Kenyan-inspired lamb bake, perfect for a solo dinner, featuring tender lamb and a blend of aromatic spices, with options for vegetarian-friendly substitutions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the lamb mixture to a baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the baking dish from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
For a vegetarian-friendly option, substitute the lamb with 1 pound of extra-firm tofu, cut into 1-inch cubes, and proceed with the recipe as instructed.
